---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or a new capability
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Who needs this, and what can they not do today?

## Goal

One or two sentences on what should be true when this is done.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A statement you can check by looking at the result
- [ ] One line per case, including the awkward ones

## Out of scope

- What this does not include

## Constraints

- Files, libraries or guidelines to follow, for example [`_docs/design-system.md`](../../_docs/design-system.md)
